a.lede: Tesla Cybertruck production will wind down in the middle of 2027 to make room for the Cybercab robotaxi.
a.title: Tesla is 'winding down' Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory

b.lede: Elon Musk defended the company's decision to stop making the Cybertruck, which will go out of production in around eight months.
b.title: Musk says Tesla will refund some Cybertruck deposits, defends decision to end production
